name: Work Permit (Employee Residence Permit)

requirements.blocker_text: An application for a work permit must be submitted at the Vergunningenloket (Permit Office) in Saliña, generally by or on behalf of the employer.
Applicant must demonstrate their own financial resources, or provide evidence of an employer's work permit request, to support a change to an employment-based residence status.

outcome.duration_length: not specified in the sources reviewed

sources.title: Immigratiedienst Curacao -- General FAQ: work permit applications at the Vergunningenloket in Saliña; residence status changes require own financial resources or an employer's work permit request

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Curacao's initial build. Fee, permit duration, and job-category/labour-market-test details were not found in the tier-1 sources reviewed in this pass -- flagged as a gap rather than guessed. switchable_to points to cw_permanent_residence.json because that route's 10-year continuous-residence clock (per the same FAQ source) can be built up while holding a work-based residence permit, though the FAQ does not explicitly confirm that work permits count toward that clock without interruption -- treat the linkage as plausible, not confirmed.
